about: An Islands of Adventure ground chunk (CONVENTIONS "Islands of Adventure (Phase 8)"), built by tools/geo/ioa_ground.py; loaded lazily by src/world/resort-patch.ts. No terrain of its own: the land lies on the fine terrain.
